newsitem.title: USA: Angeion says AngeCool trials begin.
newsitem.headline: Angeion says AngeCool trials begin.

text.p: Angeion Corp said the first human use of its AngeCool cool-tip radio-frequency catheter ablation system has been accomplished, marking the start of clinical trials with the medical device.
The device is designed for treatment of atrial arrhythmias, which are rapid chaotic rhythms in the atrium, or upper chamber of the heart.
The first human procedure was performed April 25 in North Carolina on a 53-year-old female patient, the company said.
